description: Capability for the embedded browser pane (crate::browser), the one webview that shows THIRD PARTY pages. It exists so that pressing Escape inside the pane can close the task drawer / the pane itself: the injected script relays the key press through browser_pane_escape, which only emits an event to the main window. This is the only capability with a "remote" section and the only one that names the browser-pane webview, and it must never list a second permission - anything added here is handed to every page the user opens. In the URLs below the ":*" is load bearing: these are URLPatterns, and a pattern with no port component only matches the scheme's default port, so "https://*" would silently miss https://host:8443/. The pane can only ever load http/https (crate::browser::parse_external_url), so the pair means "every page the pane can show". Enforced by the lib.rs tests the_browser_pane_capability_grants_only_the_escape_command, the_browser_pane_remote_urls_cover_http_and_https_only and capabilities_are_granted_by_webview_label.
